title: Israel's Defense Ministry announced another cargo ship with thousands of tons of "US-procured" military equipment was unloaded at Haifa Port.
text:
Israel's Defense Ministry announced another cargo ship with thousands of tons of "US-procured" military equipment was unloaded at Haifa Port. "

"Cargo includes D9 bulldozers, JLTVs, Humvees, and Oshkosh trucks.
